messages:
csm_julia: Ping — Obsidian Retail needs a short-lived region enable + rate bump for a pilot launch tomorrow morning 09:00 UTC. Renewal in ~37 days; customer says throttles are hurting the demo. Request: enable EU and APAC regions, temporary burst to ~7k rps (current sustained ~3.5k), and add CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 to allowlist for 72h. Can infra/sec stand this up and confirm?

eng_ops_mike: Ack. Quick Qs — customer account id and which hostname(s) will they hit?

csm_julia: Account OR-4421. Hostnames: api.obsidian-retail.com (prod-proxy). Demo traffic will come from the CIDR above + some engineer laptops.

infra_tina: We can do region routing + capacity bump. Need exact start/end times and an owner for cert/key handoff. I can spin up a temporary routing rule and increase pool size, but want a TTL on the allowlist entry.

csm_julia: Start: 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC. End: 72h later (2026-03-27 09:00 UTC). Owner for handoff: obsidian_support (they'll provide contact person).

infra_tina: Cool. I'll create infra ticket and do a staged rollout (canary in eu-west-1 first). Tentative commands I'll run:```bash
# add allowlist entry
dbctl allowlist add --account OR-4421 --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --expires 72h --reason "obsidian retail pilot"
# temporary route
routectl create --account OR-4421 --regions eu-west-1,ap-northeast-1 --policy priority
# scale pool
infractl scale --pool dedicated-lite-OR-4421 --replicas +2 --duration 72h
```

sec_sam: Security: short-lived CIDR is fine but we need a signed AUP and confirmation that customer won't tunnel other traffic. Also we require an allowlist audit entry and post-mortem within 7 days. Obs support, please attach the signed doc.

obsidian_support: Copy — we have the signed AUP on file (signed 2026-02-12). I'll attach it to the ticket and provide the engineer contact (maria@obsidian). We'll run a canary test tonight 02:00 UTC and post results here.

acct_mgr_dan: Noted — since renewal is in 37 days, I'll coordinate AE to follow up after the demo and offer a dedicated-capacity proposal if the pilot goes well. This is a renewal-risk -> expansion opportunity.

eng_ops_mike: One more ask: please have the customer run a quick load test with these headers so KV caching behaves similarly:```http
GET /health-check HTTP/1.1
Host: api.obsidian-retail.com
X-Client-Id: OR-4421-demo
```

deploy-bot: route-change: staged -> eu-west-1 (canary) deployed by infra_tina at 3123456890 :rocket:

infra_tina: All infra tasks created: TKT-7238 (allowlist + expiry), TKT-7239 (region routing), TKT-7240 (temp scale). I've set owner to obsidian_support for certs. ETA for full changes: 3 hours.

csm_julia: Amazing — thank you. I'll add a calendar invite for the 09:00 UTC kickoff and loop in AE. Please ping here once allowlist is in and once canary passes so I can confirm with the customer. :thumbsup:

obsidian_support: Canary ran — 200 OK, 95th p50 within expected. Uploaded canary logs to TKT-7239.

sec_sam: Allowlist entry approved and logged. Please ensure auto-remove triggers on expiry.

infra_tina: Final: allowlist added (203.0.113.0/24), routing rule active in eu & ap, pool scaled +2 replicas for 72h. All changes rolled back to baseline at expiry automatically. Marking thread resolved unless issues crop up.

csm_julia: Great — I'll tell the customer and close the loop. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
